summary: All currently authorised machine-executable implementation, deployment, database, catalogue, security, privacy-cleanup, DNS, performance, and verification work passes. The strict production release remains incomplete because accountable human approvals, authoritative duplicate decisions, credential-rotation evidence, one controlled Turnstile positive-path test, anonymous-auth rate-limit approval, and physical-device UAT are not complete.

catalogue.seller_model: Only pharmacies participate as fulfilment sellers. Products and indicative prices are central; pharmacies privately confirm availability and may optionally add a non-final estimate during customer interaction.

database_advisors.remaining_security_notes: Documented intentional controls and one plan-limited HIBP setting.

remaining_accountable_actions.action: Revoke and rotate every previously exposed Supabase service, database, personal, and deployment credential; replace the broad Cloudflare OAuth session with a least-privilege MED+250 deploy credential; attach redacted deployment receipts and signed approval.
Review the generated source-comparison packet and record a named, timestamped, reasoned decision for all 51 duplicate groups without inferring a decision from matching identifiers alone.

Complete and sign the authoritative GPS and pharmacy-authorised WhatsApp review ledgers for the intended production pharmacy set. Do not invent coordinates, contacts, stock, or pharmacy-specific prices.

Use a controlled browser to obtain a real production Turnstile token, create only a disposable anonymous auth identity without sending an availability request, delete the identity, and record a redacted positive-path test. Then review and test anonymous-auth rate limits and sign both security gates.

remaining_accountable_actions.owner: MED+250 QA owner and named physical-device operators
remaining_accountable_actions.action: Execute all 12 controlled physical-device scenarios using approved customer, pharmacy, and unrelated-pharmacy test identities. Retain redacted results and obtain named QA approval; do not contact an unintended pharmacy.

remaining_accountable_actions.owner: MED+250 operations lead, legal/compliance owner, data owner, privacy owner, backend owner, and infrastructure owner
remaining_accountable_actions.action: Review the exact gate acceptance criteria and existing evidence, provide the missing signed approvals and review ledgers, and name each approver with role and timezone-qualified timestamp. Backend and domain evidence is already complete but still requires accountable approval.

safety_conclusion: Do not fabricate approvals, duplicate decisions, physical-device results, pharmacy data, stock, prices, or a positive Turnstile result. The public catalogue is active, but formal production approval remains on hold until every strict evidence gate is genuinely confirmed and the live release check passes.
